'''Machiko Toyoshima''' (Japanese: '''豊嶋真千子''' ''Toyoshima Machiko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Toyoshima was born on December 28, 1971 in {{wp|Ibaraki Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|OS}} and provided the voices for a few Pokémon such as [[Misty's Horsea]]. Toyoshima is currently affiliated with {{wp|Aoni Production}}.
